frontal/profile human-like face with strong brow and beard-like element

justification: Both depict a humanoid figure with an emphasized head, patterned hair/beard rendering and some circular motif on the chest region, but that is about as generic as anthropomorphic imagery gets. A shows a detailed winged, bearded genie in profile with raised arm holding an object beside a stylized flowering plant, densely covered with fine incised feather and fringe patterning, whereas B is a blocky, massive, largely frontal figure with schematic sunken eyes, minimal limbs and only sparse low-relief markings; there is no shared distinctive motif, pose or compositional scheme.
